caption: The video captures a close view of a fiery, smoky environment. The left and lower portions are filled with dark, billowing smoke clouds lit from within by deep red-orange glow patches, while the upper-right region holds a bright yellow-orange luminous mass. A dense field of small, elongated bright streaks of glowing embers is scattered across the whole frame. The bright yellow-orange glow in the upper-right corner steadily intensifies and expands, gradually flooding the top-right quadrant. The dark smoke and the red-glowing cloud masses on the left and center continuously deform and shift shape, with the central-left red patch drifting slightly and changing outline. The numerous ember streaks persist throughout but individually drift and flicker. They move upward and toward the right while their brightness varies from frame to frame, keeping an overall roughly uniform density. Global contrast rises as the right side brightens relative to the still-dark lower-left smoke.
